scope.summary: Builds and deploys Power Apps code apps with React and Vite and adds Power Platform connectors such as Dataverse, SharePoint, Excel, OneDrive, Teams, Office 365 Outlook, Azure DevOps, and custom connectors. With Power Apps CLI 1.3.0+ (installed into each new project), connector skills can also create Power Platform connections in the target environment with the signed-in user's account.

externalNetworkCalls: Power Apps CLI (`@microsoft/power-apps-cli` ^1.3.0, installed per project as a dev dependency and run with `npx --no-install pa`): app init and push, data-source add, connector and connection listing, and on 1.3.0+ connection lookup and creation with the user's account
GitHub raw content (version check, degit template)

Work IQ Copilot MCP connector (`shared_a365copilotchatmcp`) — only when `/add-workiq` is used; its `CopilotChat` tool queries Microsoft 365 documents, emails, chats, sites, and files across the organization

dependencies.name: Power Platform environment with connectors enabled
dependencies.description: Target environment must allow the connectors used by generated code apps (Dataverse, SharePoint, etc.). DLP policies are managed by environment owners. DLP is enforced when the running app calls a connector (HTTP 442), not when the data source is added, so on Power Apps CLI 1.3.0+ a connector skill can create a user-owned connection in the environment before any DLP effect is visible. The plugin performs no DLP, zone, or data classification check before creating a connection.

dependencies.name: Node.js and npm
dependencies.description: Required for code app scaffolding, build tooling, and deployment.

dependencies.name: Power Apps CLI (`@microsoft/power-apps-cli` ^1.3.0) and the code apps platform feature
dependencies.description: Code apps feature must be available in the target environment. The Vite template no longer includes the CLI, so /create-code-app installs it into each project as a dev dependency (`^1.3.0`) and skills run it with `npx --no-install pa`. Existing projects on an older CLI keep the explicit connection-ID flow. In a dev container `pa` cannot open its token cache; the Equinor dev-container route uses the PAC CLI for init and deploy.

dependencies.name: Work IQ Copilot MCP connector (`shared_a365copilotchatmcp`)
dependencies.description: Soft constraint affecting one skill, not the plugin. `/add-workiq` wires in a connector whose `CopilotChat` tool performs AI-grounded search across Microsoft 365 documents, emails, chats, sites, and files organization-wide. That reach can exceed this record's `equinor-internal` data classification ceiling, and the connector's DLP position is not confirmed. **`/add-workiq` is therefore outside the controlled pilot** until DLP placement and a classification ceiling for the connector are confirmed. Every other skill in the plugin is unaffected. Since the 2026-11-19 sync, on CLI 1.3.0+ the skill adds the connector without a connection ID; Work IQ supports single sign-on, so the CLI may create the connection with the user's account after a one-line notice instead of a browser consent step. The exclusion is recorded only here; no plugin file tells the agent or the user that the skill is outside the pilot.
